title: Hands sketching on an illuminated tracing table with pencil and nearby phone

One mechanical pencil or drafting pencil is visible being held by the right-hand region; the pencil tip contacts paper.
One illuminated flat work surface or lightbox (large, white, glowing surface) occupies the lower half of the image and supports a sheet of translucent paper.
One sheet of translucent or tracing paper lies on the illuminated surface with pencil sketches or lettering on it.
One smartphone or similarly shaped rectangular device is partially visible at the right edge of the image, cropped and with only part of its body visible.
One ceramic or white cup or mug is visible in the background at the upper right, partially out of focus.
At least two rings are visible worn on fingers of the left-hand region (one large stone ring and one thinner band).
One wristwatch or wristband (dark strap, possibly leather) is visible on the wrist of the hand on the left side of the frame.
